source.title: Bangor Urban District (from 1928 Borough of Bangor), register of elections of councillors and aldermen, 1904-1958: "Register of Elections of Aldermen & Councillors" held on 16 May 1938 (PRONI LA/20/1/DA/1; Keep notes "LA/20/1/DA/1 Part 2" #35, "LA/20/1/DA/1 Part 2" #36 (photo numbers count from 0))
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Bangor Borough Council records)
source.check: candidates, votes, the result and the ward returns read from the photographed register, which the returning officer signed (owner's PRONI photographs, transcribed 10-11 Nov 2026); names as the register writes them; the register gives no party labels; candidates' addresses are not copied
confirmedBy: Northern Herald, 14 May 1938, p. 3 ("Bangor municipal election: retiring members returned")

note: Election of aldermen and councillors of the Borough of Bangor, 16 May 1938: one alderman and one councillor in each ward, all returned without a poll. Returned unopposed ("No Poll").
